elements.name: The Exam
elements.subtitle: What candidates see on the catalogue and buy. An exam holds papers; a paper holds cases. Write the exam here, then add its papers from the Papers screen.

elements.label: Slug
elements.placeholder: Left empty, generated from the title
elements.hint: Used in the exam's public address. Made unique automatically

elements.label: Subtitle
elements.placeholder: e.g. 30 rapid reporting cases under exam conditions

elements.label: Description
elements.placeholder: What this exam covers and who it is for

elements.name: Selling It
elements.subtitle: An exam does not carry its own price. It names a product, and that product's price, tax, discounts and currency are the ones the customer is actually charged — so the two can never disagree. Leave the product empty to make the exam free.

elements.label: Sold As
elements.placeholder: Search products — leave empty for a free exam
elements.hint: Create the product first under Products, priced however you like, then name it here. Buying it grants access automatically; nothing else has to be wired up. A product with no shipping requirement asks the customer for no address

elements.label: Access Window (days)
elements.hint: How long access lasts from the moment a candidate starts. Copied onto each enrolment when it is created, so changing it here affects future sittings only and never shortens a window somebody already has

elements.name: Timing and Target
elements.subtitle: The exam's duration is shown to candidates as a guide. The clock that actually runs belongs to each paper.

elements.label: Stated Duration (minutes)
elements.hint: Display only — shown on the exam card. Each paper carries the timer that counts down

elements.label: Target Score (%)
elements.hint: The percentage of the maximum a candidate is aiming at, shown before they have a score of their own

elements.label: Status
elements.hint: Only Active exams reach candidates. Inactive removes it from the catalogue and leaves every sitting intact
